title: India says foreign investment gains made before 2017 are exempt from its General Anti-Avoidance Rules, after a court required Tiger to pay $1.6B on a 2018 sale (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: India says foreign investment gains made before 2017 are exempt from its General Anti-Avoidance Rules, after a court required Tiger to pay $1.6B on a 2018 sale — India said it would not apply its strict tax evasion rules on foreign investments made before April 2017, easing concerns among global investors …
